_comment: Canonical English catalog for web-console. Keys with a leading underscore (like this one) are sentinels — skipped by codegen, parity tests, and unused-key audits. Runtime interpolation uses i18next syntax: {{count}}, {{name}}, etc.

enableAudioBanner.title: Voice playback is blocked
enableAudioBanner.description: Your browser requires a click before it will play audio in this tab.

voiceRejection.title: Speech didn't match your voice
voiceRejection.retryTitle: Transcribe the audio without speaker verification

confirmClose.title: Close terminal?
confirmClose.body: The running process in "{{name}}" will be terminated.

recoverableSessions.heading: {{count}} sessions awaiting recovery from a previous run
recoverableSessions.heading_one: 1 session awaiting recovery from a previous run
recoverableSessions.dismissTitle: Hide this orphan from the list (on-disk state preserved)
